🌟 Favnyr | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A fast, private, and highly configurable file management tool for users who need efficient organization and quick access to their files across different projects and layouts.
✨ Key Features: • Portable single executable • No installer, admin rights, or telemetry • Side-by-side panels (up to 16) • Workspaces for saving panel arrangements • Favorites across workspaces
📖 Summary: Favnyr is a modern, lightweight, and portable file manager for Windows and Linux, built with Rust and Slint. It offers a private-by-construction approach with no network requests, telemetry, or installers, focusing on user control and productivity through features like side-by-side panels, workspaces, and custom commands.
